reference.source: Ananthanarayan and Paniker's Textbook of Microbiology (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Few numb plaques: tuberculoid; many nodules: lepromatous
Reversal inflames nerves; ENL nodules with fever
reference.pathophysiology: Th1 granulomas contain bacilli in nerves while Th2 anergy lets millions seed skin and mucosa; immune complex deposition in ENL vasculitides tissues, and MAC disseminates when gut translocation outruns macrophage killing below CD4 thresholds.
additionalDifferentials: Tuberculoid versus lepromatous by bacilli, nerves and immunity
Type 1 versus type 2 reaction by neuritis versus nodules
NTM versus TB by exposure, pigment and speed
additionalInvestigations: Slit skin smears with BI and MI
CD4 with MAC blood culture in AIDS fever
Excision biopsy with NTM culture in scrofula
